name: FloatingAssistant
intent: An AI assistant that docks to the right of the page: an icon-only, corner-anchored trigger opens a full-height chat panel powered by `AIChat`. The panel takes layout width rather than floating over the page — pass the page content as `children` and it narrows to make room (built on `PushPanel`). The conversation is controlled by the consumer (`messages` + `onSendMessage`), so any domain logic can drive the replies. The trigger is the bare Core brand mark with no chrome behind it — it takes `currentColor` from `foreground`, so it inverts with the theme. Pass `icon` to swap in any other glyph. A detach control in the panel header lifts the conversation out of the layout into a floating card anchored above the trigger, and docks it back; the transition fades and scales over 200ms.
